test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 13 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The hill station Mount Abu is located in which of the following mountain chains?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aravalli.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• Aravalli is the oldest mountain range in the Indian subcontinent.
 
• The Aravali Hills lies on the western and northwestern margins of the peninsular plateau.
 
• Mount Abu is the famous hill station located in the Aravalli range.
 
• Dilwara temple is the famous **Jain pilgrim center at the Aravalli range.**
 
• Ajmer is a famous town located in the valley of Aravalli.
 
• The** Haldighat pass** is located in the Aravalli range.
 
• Mount Gurusikhar is the highest peak in the Aravalli range

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• Vindhya Range is the oldest mountain range of Madhya Pradesh.

 
 
• Kaimur hills are the easternmost hill of the Vindhya Range.
 
• Kakrabardi hills are the westernmost hill of the Vindhya Range.
 
 
 
• Satpura is the mountain located parallel to Vindhya.
 
 
• Satpura is a series of seven mountains.
 
• The highest peak in the Satpura range is Dhupgarh.
 
 
 
• The Maikal Hills is a mountain range in the state of Chhattisgarh, India.
 
 
• The Maikal Hills are located in the eastern part of Satpuras, in the Kawardha district of Chhattisgarh, overlooking the scenic town of Kawardha.
